harnesses.label: Primary Orchestrator (Claude Code)
harnesses.strengths: Architecture planning, task decomposition, complex frontend/UI/UX, PR review triage, and final closeout.
harnesses.avoid: Bulk mechanical edits, full-repo grepping, or repetitive boilerplate.

harnesses.label: P0 Plan Reviewer / Frontend Copilot (Optional)
harnesses.strengths: Second-pass critique on high-risk or cross-module P0 plans, plus complex interactive frontend work.
harnesses.avoid: Adding an extra review round on small/clear tasks; throttle when Antigravity weekly remaining is below 30%.

harnesses.label: Backend & Pre-Review Specialist
harnesses.strengths: Complex backend logic, concurrency/state-machine debugging, high-risk diff pre-review, and fallback local PR review.
harnesses.avoid: Trivial edits or redundant reviews on small non-risk PRs already covered by CI + GitHub Auto-Review.

harnesses.label: Primary Flash Worker
harnesses.strengths: Read-only codebase exploration, scoped implementation slices, unit tests, git commit/push/PR creation, and P1 review fixes.
harnesses.avoid: Polling PR status in sleep loops (use T3 native watch_pull_request instead); escalate after 2 failed review-fix rounds.

harnesses.label: Secondary Parallel Flash Worker
harnesses.strengths: Parallel worker lane alongside Pi for independent modules, cross-checks, tests, and PR operations.
harnesses.avoid: Same as Pi: no polling loops, escalate past 2 failed fix rounds.
